clue.text: Happened to have quarrelled

people who have had a falling-out are no longer on good terms

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to occur ('it fell out that') and to argue and break with someone.

clue.text: One who disposes of so-called wine store

indicators.note: so-called signals a word as it is called, that is, as it is spoken

parts.note: a cellar is where wine is stored

explanation.definitionFit: A vendor disposes of goods by selling them, so the definition is a fair paraphrase.

explanation.walkthrough: Joker here is the card, not a comic: the word names the joker in certain card games such as loo.
explanation.definitionFit: This rare word denotes the joker or wild card used in some old card games.

clue.text: Rash causing a lot of disease

an illness spreading widely through a population at once

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sudden spate of anything and a widespread outbreak of infection.

explanation.definitionFit: Jewelled ornamental bands worn on the head, as by royalty, are fair examples of headbands.

clue.text: Old Indian region has some proud history

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A former Indian territory boasting an illustrious past.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a historic kingdom and province of northern India, around Lucknow.

clue.text: New birds to rear and transport

parts.note: a hatch is a brood of newly hatched chicks
back means the rear

explanation.surface: Raising young birds and moving them about.

explanation.definitionFit: A car with a rear door that opens upward is a type of road vehicle, so an example of transport.

clue.text: Leading journalist made a bow

clue.text: People generally crack a clue that's an anagram

clue.text: I point to turn
